home.urgency.title: AI adoption is now a competitive advantage, not an option.
home.urgency.text: Companies that operate AI correctly gain productivity and keep their edge. Those that skip data preparation and governance are left with pilots that never reach production. The difference isn't the technology — it's the way of operating.
home.urgency.stat: In January–February 2026, 43% of American workers were using generative AI at work, versus a 32% average in Europe — and the gap is widening. Almost the entire gap comes down to one thing: whether the company actively encourages its people to use AI and gives them the tools and the framework to do it.
home.urgency.source: Source: Bick, Blandin, Deming, Fuchs-Schündeln & Jessen (2026), "Mind the Gap: AI Adoption in Europe and the US", CEPR DP 21337.
